player_prompt.intro:
Nga ni Player {player_id} mu Wild Tic Tac Toe.
Pa zamu yako, ungashinsha ama 'X' kapena 'O' mu square ishina.
Ungakwata kwa kupeleka vitone vitatu vya umo alama (X kapena O) mu mstari.
Ungakwata na alama yoyene.
Sala zamu yako kwa kutumia mfumo '[X 4]' uweke X katikati.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mfumo wa zamu usio sahihi. Tumia mfumo '[X 4]' kapena '[O 2]'.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Inambala ya cell iyabula insambu: {cell}. Ifwile ukuba pakati ka 0 na 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Ukubombako kwabula insambu. cell {cell} yalikwata abantu kale.

game_action.placed: Mwina {player_id} akabela symbol yake ({mark}) mu selo {cell}
